plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to reduce risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to lower concentration and build cash.
Add to QQQI to increase income allocation.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and lower volatility.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, focusing on stability over aggressive growth. Expect lower potential upside but also a reduced chance of large drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 3% and 2% respectively.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration mandate.
Slightly trim QQQI to 15% to rebalance.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor exposure.
Buy COP at 4% to add a quality name with good risk/reward.
This plan balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a quality name. It aims for risk-first growth, blending broad market exposure with selective tech and energy. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration mandate.
Trim QQQI to 10% to shift focus from income to growth.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor exposure.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to 6% each.
Buy COP at 6% to add a quality name with good risk/reward.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and adds a quality name, accepting higher potential upside and significantly larger drawdowns. Be aware of leveraged ETF decay and the amplified impact of market swings.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to build cash and reduce concentration.
Exit SMH completely to remove semiconductor exposure.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce exposure to high-beta growth.
Add to QQQI to maximize income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing stability and cash flow. It cuts leverage and high-beta single names, focusing on income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure. While aiming for low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
